requirement: During an active logging session, the Android application shall acquire valid location updates, make them available for display within the application, and write them to the user-enabled GPX, KML, and text-file outputs.
For optional OpenStreetMap and Dropbox integrations, the application shall obtain the respective service credentials from build-time configuration.

OpenGTS delivery shall use a configured server, port, communication method, and device identifier, with an optional path. When UDP is selected, the application shall send datagrams containing account and device information together with a GPRMC location report that includes UTC time and date, coordinates, speed in knots, heading, and an NMEA checksum.
